description: Paid ($0.10 USD, RLUSD or XRP on XRPL, or USDC on Base). Account statement for 1-10 XRPL addresses rolled into one: monthly periods with XRP in/out/net, fees, activity categories, per-token net change (exact decimal strings), top counterparties and plain-English statement lines. Each line carries its ledger index, transaction hash, destination and source tags and the delivered amount, and include_csv returns the lines as CSV.

address.description: XRPL r-addresses (1-10). Pass one address as a one-item list.

include_csv.description: Also return every statement line as CSV (csv.content), at most 2000 rows.

include_lines.description: Keep every statement line; by default periods above 60 transactions are collapsed.

name: xrpl_ledger_statement
